calls.summary:
# Ravid and Jake Heier
Date: 2026-10-20 | Duration: 45m

## Summary
The GrowthBook POC has verified live restart-deployment updates, cached model SaaS behavior with edge-case testing still pending, and multi-tenant targeting. Anton Bogdanov is completing SSO, approval-workflow, and role-based access testing, while A/B testing remains uncovered. A two-arm experiment is active with a fixed arm, but results are not yet feeding back into GrowthBook, preventing analytics visibility and arm-reweighting assessment. BigQuery integration requires review because service-account JSON keys do not automatically rotate; read-only, dataset- or project-level access and a temporary POC exception are being considered. Cross-project features, custom roles, and configurable approval workflows are supported, although approvals may initially remain disabled. Anton prefers Boolean-only feature toggles, with Rémy Marin confirming whether string restrictions are enforceable. Enrollment is approximately 60% of production, data arrives with about a 24-hour delay, and an initial signal may be available by Thursday. Follow-up will be coordinated in Slack.

## Keywords
BigQuery security, Multi-arm bandit testing, Feature flags, RBAC, Approval workflows, MCP integrations
